comment: Reviewed dependency allow-list for writ-rpc (M5a-04, M5-INTERFACES J-0, J-2). Only the workspace path dependency writ-kernel, which is gated by its own allow-list; no direct or transitive registry package of its own. Tokio (rt, net) is permitted by J-0 but not used. MCP, model SDKs, SQLite, HTTP and TLS stacks are forbidden anywhere in the closure.
